einzeiler: A conversation with filmmaker, hotelier, and conservationist Eric Goode.
kurzfassung: Eric Goode discusses his diverse career in filmmaking, hospitality, and wildlife conservation. He shares stories from growing up in an animal-filled home and navigating 1980s New York art scenes. The conversation also covers the creation of notable projects like Tiger King and his views on obsession and conservation.
stichpunkte: Growing up in an environment filled with animals
Experiences in Northern California's New Age movement
Directing music videos for Nine Inch Nails
Investigating reptile smugglers and stumbling into Tiger King
Perspectives on obsession, conservation, and complex moral landscapes
beschreibung:
Eric Goode (Monsters of God, Chimp Crazy, Tiger King) is a filmmaker, hotelier, and conservationist. Eric joins Armchair Expert to discuss growing up in an animal-filled home, surviving Northern California’s New Age movement, and befriending Jean-Michel Basquiat and Keith Haring in 1980s New York. Eric and Dax talk about creating legendary nightclubs and hotels, directing Nine Inch Nails videos, and stumbling into Tiger King while investigating reptile smugglers. Eric explains why obsession can give life purpose, why conservation requires talking to people you oppose, and why there is rarely one clear bad guy.
